chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ali ibn Asbat, he raised it (to the Prophet), he said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade fasting from the rising of dawn until the rising of the sun.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting between dawn and sunrise in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies the prohibition of *al-sawm* (voluntary fasting) between the emergence of true dawn (*al-fajr al-sadiq*) and sunrise, a period known as *khusuf al-nawafil*. Scholars, including Al-Tusi, interpret this as a restriction on supererogatory acts to preserve the sanctity of the obligatory fast's onset, ensuring no confusion arises between voluntary and mandatory observances. This ruling underscores the precision required in Shia jurisprudence regarding the temporal boundaries of worship.
